test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which nation-wide campaign was initiated by the Government of India on Gandhi Jayanti, 2014?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swachh Bharat Abhiyan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PM Modi **launches **SBA(Swachh Bharat Abhiyan).**
 
• The main concept of **SBA** is **cleanliness and hygiene.**
 
• **Shri Parameswaran B (I.A.S) **is the head of **SBA(Swachh Bharat Abhiyan).**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahatma Gandhi Bunkar Bima Yojana:** 

 
 
• It provides enhanced insurance cover to the handloom weavers in the case of natural as well as accidental death and also a higher sum assured.
 
 
 
• ​**Gandhi Shilp Bazar:**
 
 
• **​​**It is organized in various cities in prominent places inviting artisans from various places of the country to participate with their crafts creations and to showcase their traditional art and culture of Indian heritage.
 
 
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi Pravasi Suraksha Yojana:**
 
 
• **​MGPSY** is a voluntary scheme with the objective of protection and welfare of the emigrant workers and addressing their social security issues in **Emigration Check Required** countries.
 
• It was launched in **May 2012.**
